proof_body:
by
  intro R _ P x hP hx
  by_contra hcon
  have hd := Ideal.disjoint_nonZeroDivisors_of_mem_minimalPrimes hP
  refine Set.disjoint_left.mp hd hx (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right.mpr ?_)
  intro y hy
  by_contra hy0
  exact hcon ⟨y, hy0, by rw [mul_comm]; exact hy⟩
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (P : Ideal R) (x : R), P ∈ minimalPrimes R → x ∈ P → ∃ y : R, y ≠ 0 ∧ x * y = 0
